reason: Cache strengthening erased the apparent 1024-draw advantage in the early paired event. Test amortization across the complete declared grid, not only that event. This is transparent development, not a fresh held-out confirmation.
application_precision: For one predeclared [0,1] statistic, iid Hoeffding half-width sqrt(log(80)/(2*4096)) <0.0232 at delta=0.025; with the theoretical proposal-count refusal <=0.025 the combined guarantee is >=0.95. Timed/censored experimental output is not given that confidence certificate.
cases_methods_seeds_repetitions: All original nine inputs/48 events, all four controls and all three repetitions, unchanged. Publish 1024 losses alongside this campaign.
boundaries: No universal training benefit; a useful posterior audit at this precision needs many conditional samples. If initialization is available, correlated MCMC remains an alternative. Exact iid versus exact iid is the timed operation. Novelty/EPIC-quality/publication claims remain excluded.
